meaning: One byte-pointer displacement spelling repair. Private exported instruction bytes match the existing original-body digest; the original XBE file was not reauthenticated. ABI_UNVERIFIED, not native linkage or game behavior verification.

evidence.method: Expand exported instructions into address-keyed bytes, require exact coverage of the two body ranges, concatenate range bytes in address order, and compare SHA-256 with the canonical inventory and source header. Ignore self-reported authenticated flags. Only the two short relevant instruction windows are stored here.

instruction_windows.observation: MOV ESI,dword ptr [EBP+0x8] loads the pointer represented by piVar2 = (int *)puVar4[2].
TEST byte ptr [ESI+0x13],1 reads one byte at displacement 0x13 and tests its low bit.

case.expected_diagnostic: cast from pointer to smaller type
case.verification_boundary: Preserves the byte displacement, read width and bit predicate for a valid existing host pointer. Does not implement guest32 modular address arithmetic or translation, establish pointer provenance/object layout, recover implicit ECX/EDI/EAX inputs, certify callee or indirect-call ABI, or execute the full function.
